Michaelis et Gabrielis (93043, again 94328, 95879); De communicatione naturali libri sex (runs near 98420 and again from 99040, title block only in second copy); Constitutio Cypria (title blocks at 120309 and 120461); Sixtus IV Bulla (122507 and 123934). Page numbers are badly damaged in cols ~940-960 (Arsenius' Privilegium and Testamentum), ~560-620 and ~1060: columns recorded there are inferred from neighbouring headers; the Ordo and Elenchus agree with each other (939/941) but not with the body for Arsenius' two pieces.
Elenchus 'Formula altera in Sylburgii notis' has no column and no distinct head; left unlocated.

The Ordo has some oddly-labelled lines for Michael's Laudatio funebris pieces (Laudatio funebris eiusdem, Laudatio funebris Nicetae Choniatae, Oratio ad Alexium, Deploratio de amissa urbis Athenarum), which correspond to Monodia in Eustathium, Monodia in fratrem, Hypomnesticon, Iambi in the Elenchus.
Elenchus 'Ex libro XXII' (Eustratius) is 'Ex libro XXIII' in the body and the Ordo.
